name: @pipeworx/mcp-timeapi-io

tools.name: current_time
tools.description: Return the current date and time for a given IANA timezone (e.g. America/New_York): year, month, day, hour, minute, second, millisecond, dayOfWeek, dstActive.

tools.name: current_iso_zoned_date_time
tools.description: Return the current date/time for a given IANA timezone as a full ISO 8601 zoned datetime string (e.g. 2026-06-24T10:30:00+02:00).

tools.name: current_zone_info
tools.description: Return timezone metadata for an IANA zone name: UTC offset, DST offset, current offset, DST start/end, and whether DST is currently active.

tools.name: day_of_the_week
tools.description: Day of week for a date.

tools.name: list_zones
tools.description: Return all IANA timezone names supported by TimeAPI.io. Use as a directory to find valid timeZone strings for other calls.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-timeapi-io forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the timeapi-io pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
